## Note

**Whistral never uploads audio.** All transcription happens locally on your Mac. If your report involves a specific phrase or dictation result, please *describe the phrase in words* (e.g. it transcribed "hello world" as "hello whirled") — do not attach or share raw audio recordings or personal audio files.
